Piccolo Lv.3 (Saiyan Saga - #163) - “Multi-form allows two physical attacks, one after the
other” explained: Multi-form performs two physical attacks. The controlling player performs a
physical attack, that player’s opponent defends, the controlling player performs another
physical attack, that player’s opponent defends. Then the opponent can attack, and Combat
continues as usual.
